page_title: GET 0-1 ATM | Getafe v Atletico Madrid 23/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' The resulting corner, taken by Alex Sancris (Getafe), comes to nothing.
90+5' Alex Sancris (Getafe) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Getafe.
90+5' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) fires a shot from close range, but he is somehow only able to hit the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
90+4' Alex Sancris (Getafe) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
90+3' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) commits a rough foul. Guillermo Cuadra stops the game and makes a call. Getafe will take a free kick.
90+1' Juan Musso (Atl. Madrid) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' A substitution has been made. Luis Milla is replaced by Javier Munoz (Getafe).
88' Coba da Costa (Getafe) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Juan Musso intercepts the ball.
87' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to make a change. Juanmi (Getafe) replaces Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez.
86' Here comes a substitution. Alex Sancris (Getafe) is brought on as a substitute for Mario Martin.
86' The ratio of the ball possession is 39:61.
82' 0 - 1 It's an own goal! A pitiful moment for Domingos Duarte (Getafe), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box but instead sends the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 0:1.
81' Referee Guillermo Cuadra has finally had enough of Diego Simeone and brandishes a yellow card at him!
80' The resulting corner from Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) is cleared.
80' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Atl. Madrid earn a corner.
79' Mario Martin (Getafe) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.

78' What a poor attempt! Luis Milla (Getafe) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
77' The substitution has been made. Kiko Femenia (Getafe) has replaced Abdel Abqar.
76' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to substitute Adrian Liso and he is replaced by Coba da Costa (Getafe).
76' Luis Milla (Getafe) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but the ball goes narrowly over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.

75' A free kick is awarded from a very dangerous distance. It's situated just a few metres from outside the box. Several players gather around the ball, but it seems like Luis Milla (Getafe) is going to have a crack himself.
75' Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) makes a slide tackle, but referee Guillermo Cuadra blows for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Getafe.
75' Adrian Liso (Getafe) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
74' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
72' A header by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) from very close range goes towards the middle of the target, but doesn't get past David Soria, who makes a nice save.
72' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

71' Great solo effort by Giacomo Raspadori (Atl. Madrid) as he tricks his way through two defenders before firing a drive from just outside of the box towards the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper is ready and produces a stunning save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Atl. Madrid.
69' Diego Simeone prepares a substitution. Matteo Ruggeri is replaced by Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid).
69' Nicolas Gonzalez comes off the pitch to be replaced by David Hancko (Atl. Madrid).

68' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick shot to the right side of the goal, but he can't get the power to direct it past David Soria, who keeps it out.
68' Atl. Madrid players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
66' The shots on goal statistics – 1:3.
64' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

63' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) gathers a nice lofted pass deep inside the box and attempts to put the ball inside the right post, but his shot is deflected away by one of the defending players. The linesman points to the corner flag, Atl. Madrid are going to take it.

62' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the bottom right corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
62' Luis Milla (Getafe) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
60' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
59' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Julian Alvarez will be replaced by Giacomo Raspadori (Atl. Madrid).
59' Koke will be replaced by Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid).
57' Guillermo Cuadra shows a yellow card to Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) for his blatant foul.
56' Luis Milla (Getafe) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

56' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball goes out of play and Getafe have been awarded a corner kick.
55' Luis Milla (Getafe) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
55' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Getafe get a corner.
54' Luis Milla (Getafe) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

53' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The ball goes behind for a corner. Getafe will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
52' Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Getafe get a free kick.

50' Luis Milla sends the free kick into the box. Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) outjumps the defence to win the header, but completely mistimes the ball and sends it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
50' Getafe have been awarded a free kick.
49' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
48' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
46' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) attempts to outfox the defender, but he only tricks himself after getting caught in the offside trap.

43' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the bottom left corner, but David Soria is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
42' The foul by Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) was seen by Guillermo Cuadra who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. Getafe have a free kick.
40' Abdel Abqar (Getafe) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Guillermo Cuadra had an easy-decision to make.
39' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) sprays a pass out to Alex Baena, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
37' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
34' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) commits a rough challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Getafe will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
33' Adrian Liso (Getafe) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.

31' Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. Getafe will take a free kick near the side line.
30' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul after Adrian Liso (Getafe) hacks down one of his opponents.
28' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

28' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Atl. Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner.
26' Mario Martin (Getafe) commits a foul and Guillermo Cuadra immediately signals a free kick.
23' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
19' Great teamplay by Getafe as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
18' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 36:64.
14' Diego Simeone is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Marcos Llorente suffers an injury and Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) comes on.
12' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

10' Luis Milla (Getafe) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
10' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle after Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. A free kick to Getafe.

9' Matteo Ruggeri smashes in a cross, but Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) finds it almost impossible to control and sends his header high over the bar from close in. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
7' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

6' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the right side of the goal. David Soria shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net. The referee blows his whistle, Atl. Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
6' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
5' The ball is cleared after Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Atl. Madrid force a corner. They send men into the box.
3' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
3' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Atl. Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
2' Neat passing move from Atl. Madrid in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Getafe will have the kick-off.
Guillermo Cuadra will referee today's match.
